In order to officially become a phantom thief, Delta joins the Thieves of Justice as a trainee.
To embody the stealthy and silent nature of a phantom thief, she decides to become a ninja thief.

levels.name: Ninjutsu Camouflage
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to squad formation. Only one set of effects is applied.</color>
Activates if there are no other Defender allies in the squad. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Effect 1: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to 7.24% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP that lasts for 10 sec.
Effect 2: Attract: Taunts all enemies continuously.</color>
Activates if there is another Defender ally in the squad. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Effect 1: Ninjutsu Camouflage: <word_group=10004>Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks</word_group> for 10 sec. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit.
Effect 2: Ninjutsu Injection: Restores HP equal to 6.17% of attack damage. This effect is continuous.</color>
■ Activates after performing 200 normal attacks while in the Attract state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to 7.24% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP that lasts for 10 sec.</color>
■ Activates every 4 sec while in the Ninjutsu Injection state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Ninjutsu IFAK: Lasts for 4 sec.
Function: Stores up HP recovery for a time, after which all allies are healed for the stored amount.
Effect 1: The maximum amount stored is equal to 90.9% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK.
Effect 2: Once the duration ends, all allies are healed for the <word_group=10089>stored recovery amount</word_group>.</color>

lines.text: The most important things to a ninja are stealth, technique, and situational awareness—and of course, teamwork.

Although I'm still a trainee as a phantom thief,
as a ninja, I'm confident I've risen to a high level.

The path of a phantom thief and the path of a ninja...
Only those who can walk both can truly be called a ninja thief.

I can teach you all the secret techniques I've learned, Commander—just for you.
So, how about becoming a ninja thief with me?
My shuriken will never be aimed at you, Commander.
It's an honor to walk the path of a ninja thief alongside you, Commander. Nin-nin!

If I have to wait for you, may I do so up in the ceiling?
Standing around here like this is unbecoming of a ninja.

I can't see your face clearly from inside the ceiling.
I'll just wait here instead.

Wha...! How did you find me?
I was certain I was moving like a shadow.

A summons, for the Thieves of Justice?
I shall depart at once.

I've sent the calling card.
I'll see you at midnight.
Delta, trainee ninja thief. Nin-nin!
I can move more stealthily and quietly now.
I can learn new techniques now. I shall train and return soon.
Thank you for your support. I'll work on developing new ninja weapons.

This is real, and not an illusion created by ninjutsu?
... I'm sincerely grateful.
You're the only one who prepares such things for me, Commander.
I'll repay you by spreading the name of the Thieves of Justice.

My heartbeat is too loud.
It makes it hard for me to move quietly.
I'll give my best to officially join the Thieves of Justice, so I can stand proudly alongside you, Commander.
So... is romance within the company—I mean, the organization—off limits?
Trainee ninja thief, ready for duty.
Nin-nin!
Footsteps must not be heard.
Enemy sighted. Approaching quietly.
Ninjutsu! Commence battle!
I'll show you the results of my training.
I will leave no trace behind.
Shuriken retrieved.
Ninjutsu! Reload!
I must hide in the shadows for a bit.
Ninjutsu, ready.
Secret technique! Ninja Overdrive!
I'll show you the power of justice!
Justice has been served.
Nin-nin!
A perfect hit.
Ugh...!
Gah...!
Nin...!
As expected... I still have much to learn as a trainee.
Even a trainee ninja thief can pull this off.
